_doc: Two-corner engine test. Shared by Godot, Three.js and tools/sim_parity.py. No balance numbers here: stats come from sim constants by name.
_pin_doc: Re-pinned from c3ffc41 to 50928ed (newest proto-build containing Barry's 53267c5 stat-name rename: Stance.POW/EN/HAN, DRAW, P/E/H line letters; numbers identical). QTE rounding from c3ffc41 is in this pin. Austin's naming rule, 2026-11-12: backend is POW/EN/HAN only; IN/MID/OUT is visual. sim/ is unchanged after 53267c5 (later commits are design/story/ci/godot).
_max_turns_doc: race length in turns = corners; kappa = kappa_for_length(2) -> nearest key 10 (sim rule, no interpolation)

stats._doc: simulation.simulate_win_rate convention: Balanced builds, opp_total = SABINE_BUDGET (300.0, same value as simulate_win_rate's default), player total = r * opp_total, r = LADDER_R[rung]. Each stat = total / 3.0.

corners._doc: Austin 2026-11-11 ~10 PM PT: both corners in one district on a continuous 2-turn track (he picked Touge). N90 is corner 7 of tracks_v1 T1_Akina_Switchbacks; its Touge line set (LINE_SET_C touge N90) replaces Street N90's for the rival. Was street N90 R.

_dir_doc: corner direction is display-only (lane tell side). LINE_SET_C / tracks_v1 carry no L/R; PLACEHOLDER.
_qte_window_mod_doc: MatchConfig.qte_window_mod (sim/velocity_shift/models.py:157, default 0.0). No mods in this test. Zone = qte_zone_width(r, qte_window_mod) at the race's fixed r = player stat total / opponent stat total (match.py:190-192).
